q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a disposable syringe?
title: Disposable syringe carbon footprint per piece
short: Add the polypropylene barrel and plunger, rubber gasket and needle per syringe with supplier figures. Add moulding, assembly, printing, packing and sterilisation energy, then divide by syringes packed.

ul: Rubber gasket and stainless steel needle.
Sterilisation by ethylene oxide or radiation.

p: Report per syringe by size. Clean room air handling can be a large share of plant electricity, so meter it.

example.title: Worked example: disposable syringe unit per piece (one month)
lines: Plant total: 42,600 / 2,000,000 = 0.0213 kg CO2 per piece
Add polymer, needle and packing for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
